name: Motorcycle Simulator Maryland
summary:
The ride of your life, from the seat - all the way round Baltimore, Maryland.

YOUR GARAGE
Start astride your bike in a luxury three-car garage in Westport. Touch the throttle and the door lifts onto the street.

THE BIKE
A litre-class sport bike: a live colour dash with speed, gear, lean angle and a map, two live mirrors, a smoked bubble screen.

RIDE IT LIKE A REAL BIKE
Grip the bars with your own hands. Roll your right wrist back to open the throttle, brake with your left hand, push the bars to lean into
